text:
Anya Patel: Quick sync — need a decision on scope for the model-lifecycle sprint. Two discrete items: (A) onboarding path for Mistral-Edge-v1 as a lightweight candidate (hosted + dedicated smoke) and (B) phased migration for gpt-legacy-3 pinned tenants. Proposal: 2-week canary for A, staggered migration windows for B. Thoughts?
Samir Rao: +1 to canary, but we need clear SLO gates. who owns perf sign-off?
Julian Kim: I can own perf sign-off for (A) if infra provides canary nodes and KV cache warmers. Need perf harness ready by Wed.
Maria Lopez: For customer migration (B) we need an opt-in communication plan and a fallback pin for 30 days. Legal/customer success will require a rollback SLA in writing.
Ivy Chen: From console/telemetry POV: add a quality regression check tied to our eval set (subset of top-50 customer prompts). If regression > 5% we halt.
Theo Grant: Ops: capacity-wise, Mistral-Edge-v1 needs different memory profile. Recommend a dedicated 2-GPU canary pool, auto-scale disabled for first 48h.
Anya Patel: Adding suggested objective thresholds — please confirm:
```
Acceptance gates for onboarding Mistral-Edge-v1:
- p95 latency <= 120ms for baseline prompt set
- token-cost delta <= +8% vs current baseline model
- regression pass rate >= 92% on eval_set_v1 (top-50 prompts)
- no more than 1 customer-facing error spike >5min in canary window
Canary window: 14 days with daily checks and a formal review on day 7 and day 14.
```
Samir Rao: Those thresholds look reasonable. Clarify token-cost delta: is that per-token bill or estimated infra cost?
Maria Lopez: We should surface both numbers to customers: per-token billing delta and estimated monthly infra delta for their pinned quota.
Julian Kim: Perf harness note: need to run mixed-batch load (10-70 tokens per request). Will run 3x at 0.1/0.5/0.9 QPS levels.
Ivy Chen: Adding monitoring hooks: we will create a "ml.catalog.onboard.mistral-edge-v1" dashboard with these charts: latency_p95, regress_pass_rate, cache_hit_ratio, errors_5m_window.
Theo Grant: For migration path of gpt-legacy-3: propose staged cohorts: internal -> beta customers (opt-in) -> pinned customers (notification + 30d opt-out) -> auto-migrate at 60d. Rollback window 14d after each cohort.
Maria Lopez: Customer comm template draft: short email explaining benefits, expected token-cost change, links to rollback opt-out, contact for support. I can draft and share.
Anya Patel: Decision needed by EOD Friday so we can scope sprint. Two asks: (1) approve thresholds and canary plan for Mistral-Edge-v1 (2) approve staged cohort migration plan for gpt-legacy-3.
Samir Rao: Approve (1) pending perf harness run. Approve (2) pending CS sign-off on comm template.
Julian Kim: I will post perf harness results by Thursday midday.
Maria Lopez: I will share comm template and legal check by Thursday EOD.
Ivy Chen: I'll provision the dashboard and alert runbook by Thursday.
Theo Grant: I'll reserve the 2-GPU canary pool and set autoscale off for 48h.
ops-bot: Canary task created: mistral-edge-v1-canary-5188881234 — status: scheduled.
Anya Patel: Thanks everyone — if all thumbs up by Friday EOD we'll lock this into the sprint and create the backfill tickets (benching, rollout runbook, comms).
